fields.description: Master switch. Off by default; Head Office switches it on. Maison Boutique.face_recognition_enabled (Inherit / On / Off) overrides per store.

fields.description: Embedding model the POS ships. Templates are only matched against embeddings of the same model.
fields.label: Recognition model

fields.description: Maximum euclidean distance between RAW face-api descriptors for a match (face-api rule: < 0.6 = same person). Lower = stricter. Devices may only tighten it. The API reports distance plus a display score = 1 − distance/1.2.
fields.label: Match threshold (distance)

fields.description: Templates of clients with no visit for this many months are destroyed by the daily purge (BIPA retention policy).
fields.label: Biometric retention (months)

fields.description: Allow POS devices to cache consented templates for offline matching (recognition.templates).
fields.label: Offline template cache

fields.description: Bump whenever the consent text changes; every consent record stores the version and a snapshot of the text.
fields.label: Consent text version

fields.default: I agree that Maison may create and store a mathematical template of my facial features (a "face template") so that this boutique can recognise me and offer personalised service when I visit. No photograph or video of my face is kept; only the template. Maison will not sell, lease or trade my face template, will not use it for any purpose other than identifying me as a client, and will permanently destroy it when I withdraw my consent, when I have not visited a Maison boutique for 36 months, or sooner if required by law — whichever comes first. I may withdraw this consent at any time by asking any boutique manager or by writing to privacy@maison.example. Maison's Biometric Data Retention and Destruction Policy is available at every boutique and on maison.example/privacy/biometrics.
fields.description: Shown to the client on the enrolment consent screen (large type). See docs/biometrics-policy.md for EN/ES versions.
